chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Muhammad ibn Abdillah ibn Zur'arah, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): Regarding

a man who married a woman, then divorced her so she became separated, then another man married her for a temporary period (mut'ah); is she permissible for her first husband? He said, 'No, until she enters into what she exited from.'

key_terms.تَدْخُلَ فِيمَا خَرَجَتْ مِنْهُ: enters into what she exited from (referring to consummation)
key_terms.فَبَانَتْ: so she became separated (completed the waiting period)

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for a man to remarry his ex-wife after she has been married to another man in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith clarifies the specific condition of 'tamkin' (consummation) required for a woman to become lawful to her first husband after a 'mut'ah' (temporary) marriage to a second man, distinguishing it from permanent marriage rules. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling is significant because it confirms that a temporary marriage, if consummated, fully severs the marital bond, allowing the first husband to remarry her without a new contract or waiting period, provided the condition of entry is met.
